WELCOME

Welcome, we’re excited to see you soon!

Everything you need to prepare, travel, and arrive ready is gathered here in one focused guide, making the weeks before the Institute feel clear, organized, and manageable.

Welcome to the 2026 Healthcare HR Management Institute—an exclusive opportunity to connect with senior Healthcare HR executives, gain valuable industry insights, and build meaningful business relationships.

To help you maximize your experience and ensure a successful event, there are a few important pre-event steps to complete in the weeks ahead. This guide outlines everything you need to know, including key deadlines, deliverables, and event details.

Your Operations Lead, Katrina Brightling, will be available throughout the planning process to answer questions, provide support, and ensure you are fully prepared for a productive and successful event experience.

YOUR OPERATIONS LEAD

Katrina Brightling

BEFORE YOU ARRIVE

Preparing for your Institute is as easy as 1-2-3.

Complete these Sponsor Hub deliverables so your onsite team and meeting strategy are ready well before arrival.

Submit Your Delegate Profiling Question, Company Details & Logo

Submit your company profile information and one Delegate Profiling Question for inclusion in the delegate profile questionnaire. These details help attendees better understand your organization, products, and services, while the questionnaire responses provide valuable insights into delegate priorities and challenges to support more informed and productive business meeting selections.

Register Onsite Attendees & Submit Hotel Needs

Please identify all individuals from your organization, including presenters, who will be attending the event, and submit their information via the Register Onsite Attendees section of the Sponsor Hub. Your Operations Lead will add them to the event roster and coordinate their hotel accommodations.

One-on-One Meeting Selections

Review the Delegate Profile Summaries and identify your top preferences for your pre-scheduled one-on-one business meetings.

YOUR DIGITAL HOME BASE

Sponsor Hub.

The Sponsor Hub is the central resource for managing your organization’s participation in the event. Through the Hub, you can submit a custom Delegate Profiling Question, update your company information, register your onsite attendees, complete the business meeting selection process, review key dates and deliverables, and access important event information and resources.

Sponsor Hub login credentials are provided by your Operations Lead in their welcome email, which is typically sent 8–10 weeks prior to the event start date.

OPEN SPONSOR HUB

ARRIVE WITH CONFIDENCE

Hotel & Travel.

The essentials for your stay at Grande Lakes, from room coverage to local transportation.

The Ritz-Carlton, Orlando, FL
4012 Central Florida Pkwy, Orlando, FL 32837, United States
Hotel Reservations

Secure your reservation by submitting your hotel needs through the Attendee Hub’s “Book Hotel” tab by the deadline. Your participation includes two nights; additional nights, if available, are $335 per night plus a $25 nightly resort fee, payable at check-out.

REQUEST RESERVATION SUPPORT
Transportation

Guests are responsible for arranging their own transportation to and from the hotel. For destination information and helpful local recommendations, please visit the Attendee Hub.

MAKE EVERY CONVERSATION COUNT

Business Meetings & Onsite Experience.

Business meetings are pre-scheduled based on the priorities and preferences submitted by both Service Providers and attending executives.

How Meetings Are Scheduled
1. Mutual Requests

Both parties have selected one another.

2. Delegate Requests

The executive has requested your organization.

3. Service Provider Requests

Your organization has requested the executive.

Opt-Outs

A confidential Opt-Out feature is available during the selection process, allowing you to exclude specific organizations from your schedule and keep your meetings focused on the conversations most relevant to your business objectives.

Meeting Schedule

Your personalized business meeting schedule will be released on the Tuesday prior to the event, providing ample time to review your itinerary, research attendees, and prepare for productive onsite discussions.

Meeting Space

Our team will take care of all meeting space setup on your behalf, including signage, tables, chairs, power, lighting, and Wi-Fi. For photos and additional details about the meeting environment, please visit the FAQ section of the Sponsor Hub.

Thought Leadership Sessions

Sponsors are invited to attend the Thought Leadership Sessions and gain valuable insights from industry leaders through panel discussions and case studies focused on the most pressing issues facing healthcare HR executives. Visit the Sponsor Hub to view the agenda and session details.

Networking Opportunities

Enjoy enhanced networking opportunities including daily interactive group meals, engaging icebreaker activities, and refreshing coffee breaks, all thoughtfully designed to facilitate meaningful connections within the group.

NEED AN ANSWER?

Sponsor Support Lives in the Hub.

Visit the Sponsor Hub for a comprehensive FAQ section covering a wide range of topics, including pre-event deliverables, hotel reservations, business meetings, shipping instructions, onsite logistics, and post-event follow-up details.

VISIT THE SPONSOR HUB
